policy.description: JabTracker Test Coverage Policy - Tiered approach based on component complexity

pure_business_logic.description: Core business logic with minimal framework dependencies

infrastructure.description: Data management with some framework dependencies

view_models.description: ObservableObject classes with testable business logic

utilities.description: Helper functions, extensions, and utility classes

cloudkit_integration.description: CloudKit methods tested via E2E UI tests rather than unit tests
cloudkit_integration.rationale: CloudKit requires real iCloud account and network connectivity, making unit testing impractical and unreliable
cloudkit_integration.unit_test_approach: Business logic around CloudKit status handling is tested with mocks

authentication_integration.description: Real Sign in with Apple tested via E2E, mocked scenarios via unit tests
authentication_integration.test_approach: Hybrid - E2E for real authentication flows, unit tests for error handling and state management

overall_target.note: Overall coverage percentage is informational due to SwiftUI architecture limitations
